topic.title: Blackjack Game
topic.description: A text-based Blackjack (21) game against the computer. Implements card drawing, Ace value adjustment (11→1), and computer AI that draws until 17.

learningNotes.whatILearned: Using a list to represent a deck, randomly drawing cards, handling the special Ace case, and implementing simple computer AI logic.
learningNotes.challenges: Correctly reducing Ace from 11 to 1 when the hand total exceeds 21 without over-correcting.
learningNotes.nextSteps: Add betting mechanics, split, and double-down options.

files.description: Full Blackjack game with Ace handling and computer AI.
